$comment: The deploy's smoke checks and the surfaces the golden turn drives (T-0580). scripts/smoke-report.py maps a PASS line to a check by its prefix, and a section header to the checks it runs; the adapter accepts only these ids; the board lists them in this order under `words` (17 characters at most: the board's row name). scripts/verify/golden-turn.mjs reports each surface as passed, failed or skipped with a reason. A new PASS line in scripts/smoke.sh needs a row (deploy/tests/test_smoke_report.py).

The context window fits the model server
